five_authorities.name: Human operator
five_authorities.owns: grants authority, approves sensitive actions, chooses policy and scope
five_authorities.must_not: delegate semantic/runtime truth to a model

five_authorities.name: Trusted dispatcher
five_authorities.owns: validates identity, operation, arguments and scope; invokes fixed capabilities
five_authorities.must_not: interpret natural language or invent AIpinho contracts

five_authorities.name: Local execution broker
five_authorities.owns: routes already-authorized operations to Git, tests, build, FireTest or AIpinho

five_authorities.name: AIpinho runtime
five_authorities.owns: meaning, intent, contract, planning, governed execution, evidence binding, validation, RuntimeTruth and SpeakerTruth ceiling

five_authorities.name: Evidence/result layer
five_authorities.owns: auditable proof, outputs, diagnostics and validation evidence
five_authorities.must_not: invent success, hide blocked outcomes or grant runtime authority

canonical_runtime_chain: domain executor / readonly specialized child / TaskRuntime-bound RolePipeline
SemanticOffer -> Offer/Demand Compatibility -> N-way -> GraphRevision -> SemanticCompletionTruth
invariants: producer completion does not authorize consumer usage
same Offer may differ per edge
graph revision invalidates historical authority for active child graph
Doctor diagnoses but never grants authority
roles are TaskRuntime children, not a parallel runtime
FireTest is regression evidence, not runtime configuration
